title.zh: 卷十 帝紀第十 帝 恭帝
title.en: Volume 10 Annals 10: Emperor An; Emperor Gong
title.raw: 卷十 帝紀第十 帝 恭帝 Volume 10 Annals 10: Emperor An; Emperor Gong

sentences.zh: 安皇帝諱德宗，字德宗，孝武帝長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor An's taboo name was Dezong; his courtesy name was Dezong; he was the eldest son of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An, whose personal name was Dezong and whose courtesy name was likewise Dezong, was the eldest son of Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 太元十二年八月辛巳，立爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the eighth month of the twelfth year of the Taiyuan era, he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Taiyuan, on xinsi day in the eighth month, he was invested as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十一年九月庚申，孝武帝崩。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the ninth month of the twenty-first year, Emperor Xiaowu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the ninth month of the twenty-first year of Taiyuan, Emperor Xiaowu passed away.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太子卽皇帝位，大赦。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the crown prince assumed the imperial throne; there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the crown prince ascended the throne, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以司徒、會稽王道子爲太傅，攝政。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, Sima Daozi, Minister of Education and Prince of Kuaiji, was appointed Grand Tutor and exercised regency.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Sima Daozi—who held the posts of Minister of Education and Prince of Kuaiji—was named Grand Tutor and assumed the regency.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiashen day.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on jiashen day,

sentences.zh: 葬孝武皇帝于隆平陵。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu was buried at Longping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu was interred at the Longping imperial tomb.

sentences.zh: 大雪。

translations.literal: Heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: There was heavy snowfall.

sentences.zh: 隆安元年春正月己亥朔，帝加元服，改元，增文武位一等。

translations.literal: First year of Long'an, spring, first month, first day of the cycle jihai: the emperor assumed the cap of adulthood, changed the era name, and raised civil and military ranks by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Long'an, on new year's day jihai, the emperor came of age, the reign title was changed, and every civil and military rank was advanced one step.

sentences.zh: 太傅、會稽王道子稽首歸政。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor and Prince of Kuaiji Sima Daozi bowed his head and returned the government.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Sima Daozi, Prince of Kuaiji, formally surrendered the reins of government.

sentences.zh: 以尚書右僕射王珣爲尚書令，領軍將軍王國寶爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Wang Xun, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Director of the Secretariat; Wang Guobao, General Who Guards the Army, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xun advanced from Right Vice Director of the Secretariat to Director of the Secretariat, while Wang Guobao—General Who Guards the Army—was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二月，呂光將禿髮烏孤自稱大都督、大單于，國號南涼。

translations.literal: In the second month, Lü Guang's general Tufa Wugu styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief and Grand Chanyu; his state's name was Southern Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Tufa Wugu, who served under Lü Guang, proclaimed himself Grand Commander-in-Chief and Grand Chanyu and adopted the dynastic title Southern Liang.

sentences.zh: 擊光將竇苟于金昌，大破之。

translations.literal: He attacked Lü Guang's general Dou Gou at Jinchang and utterly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: He struck Dou Gou, one of Lü Guang's commanders, at Jinchang and routed him.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，尊皇太后李氏爲皇太后。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Lady Li was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Lady Li was formally recognized as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立皇后王氏。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Lady Wang was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Lady Wang was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 三月，呂光子纂爲乞伏乾歸所敗。

translations.literal: In the third month, Lü Guang's son Lü Zuan was defeated by Qifu Gangui.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Lü Zuan, Lü Guang's son, suffered defeat at the hands of Qifu Gangui.

sentences.zh: 光建康太守段業自號涼州牧。

translations.literal: Duan Ye, administrator of Jiankang under Lü Guang, styled himself Governor of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ye, whom Lü Guang had appointed prefect of Jiankang, proclaimed himself Governor of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 慕容寶敗魏師于薊。

translations.literal: Murong Bao defeated Wei forces at Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Bao turned back the Wei army at Ji.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，兗州刺史王恭，豫州刺史庾楷舉兵，以討尚書左僕射王國寶、建威將軍王緒爲名。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiaxu day: Wang Gong, Inspector of Yanzhou, and Yu Kai, Inspector of Yuzhou, raised troops, nominally to punish Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Guobao and General Who Establishes Might Wang Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jiaxu day, Wang Gong of Yanzhou and Yu Kai of Yuzhou took up arms on the pretext of punishing Wang Guobao, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Wang Xu, General Who Establishes Might.

sentences.zh: 甲申，殺國寶及緒以悅于恭，恭乃罷兵。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Guobao and Xu were executed to please Gong; Gong then dismissed his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Wang Guobao and Wang Xu were put to death to placate Wang Gong, who thereupon stood his army down.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 五月，前司徒長史王廞以吳郡反，王恭討平之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Wang Yin, former chief clerk of the Minister of Education, rebelled with Wu commandery; Wang Gong attacked and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wang Yin, erstwhile chief clerk to the Minister of Education, rose in Wu commandery; Wang Gong marched against him and crushed the revolt.

sentences.zh: 慕容寶將慕容詳僭卽皇帝位于中山，寶奔黃龍。

translations.literal: Murong Bao's general Murong Xiang usurped the imperial seat at Zhongshan; Bao fled to Huanglong.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Xiang, a commander under Murong Bao, seized the throne at Zhongshan in defiance of legitimate succession, while Murong Bao withdrew toward Huanglong.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，呂光爲其僕射楊軌、散騎常侍郭黁所攻，光子纂擊走之。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month: Lü Guang was attacked by his Vice Director Yang Gui and Attendant Cavalry Gentleman Guo Nen; Lü Guang's son Lü Zuan struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, Vice Director Yang Gui and Attendant Cavalry Gentleman Guo Nen turned against Lü Guang; Lü Zuan, Lü Guang's son, counterattacked and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 九月，慕容寶將慕容麟斬慕容祥于中山，因僭卽皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Murong Bao's general Murong Lin beheaded Murong Xiang at Zhongshan and thereupon usurped the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Murong Lin, serving Murong Bao, executed Murong Xiang at Zhongshan and then proclaimed himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，慕容麟爲魏師所敗。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Murong Lin was defeated by Wei forces.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Wei troops defeated Murong Lin.

sentences.zh: 二年春三月，龍舟二災。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, third month: two dragon boats suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring in the second year of Long'an, fire or mishap struck two imperial dragon boats.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，蘭汗弑慕容寶而自稱大將軍、昌黎王。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: Lan Han murdered Murong Bao and styled himself Grand General and Prince of Changli.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, Lan Han assassinated Murong Bao and assumed the titles Grand General and Prince of Changli.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，慕容寶子盛斬蘭汗，僭稱長樂王，攝天子位。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Murong Bao's son Murong Sheng executed Lan Han, styled himself Prince of Changle, and held the Son of Heaven's position in proxy.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Murong Sheng, Murong Bao's son, killed Lan Han, took the title Prince of Changle without imperial sanction, and exercised imperial authority.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史王恭、豫州刺史庾楷、荊州刺史殷仲堪、廣州刺史桓玄、南蠻校尉楊佺期等舉兵反。

translations.literal: Wang Gong, Inspector of Yanzhou; Yu Kai, Inspector of Yuzhou; Yin Zhongkan, Inspector of Jingzhou; Huan Xuan, Inspector of Guangzhou; Yang Quanqi, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians; and others raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong of Yanzhou, Yu Kai of Yuzhou, Yin Zhongkan of Jingzhou, Huan Xuan of Guangzhou, Yang Quanqi as Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, and others rose in arms.

sentences.zh: 八月，江州刺史王愉奔于臨川。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Wang Yu, Inspector of Jiangzhou, fled to Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wang Yu, governor of Jiangzhou, escaped to Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，寧朔將軍鄧啓方及慕容德將慕容法戰于管城，王師敗績。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, General Who Pacifies the North Deng Qifang and Murong De's general Murong Fa fought at Guancheng; the royal army suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Deng Qifang, General Who Pacifies the North, and Murong Fa, under Murong De, clashed at Guancheng; the court army was routed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，慕容盛僭卽皇帝位于黃龍。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Murong Sheng usurped the imperial throne at Huanglong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Murong Sheng declared himself emperor at Huanglong.

sentences.zh: 桓玄大敗王師于白石。

translations.literal: Huan Xuan greatly defeated the royal army at Baishi.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan shattered the imperial forces at Baishi.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，加太傅、會稽王道子黃鉞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the xinmao day, Grand Tutor and Prince of Kuaiji Sima Daozi was given the yellow axe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the ninth month Grand Tutor Sima Daozi, Prince of Kuaiji, was invested with the ceremonial yellow axe—full authority to execute.

sentences.zh: 遣征虜將軍會稽王世子元顯、前將軍王珣、右將軍謝琰討桓玄等。

translations.literal: General Who Subdues the Caitiffs and heir of the Prince of Kuaiji Sima Yuanxian, Former General Wang Xun, and Right General Xie Yan were dispatched to punish Huan Xuan and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Sima Yuanxian—the Prince of Kuaiji's heir and General Who Subdues the Caitiffs—along with Former General Wang Xun and Right General Xie Yan to campaign against Huan Xuan and his allies.

sentences.zh: 己亥，破庾楷于牛渚。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Yu Kai was defeated at Niuzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day government troops defeated Yu Kai at Niuzhu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，會稽王道子屯中堂，元顯守石頭。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, Prince of Kuaiji Sima Daozi encamped at the Central Hall; Yuanxian guarded Stone Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Sima Daozi, Prince of Kuaiji, took station in the Central Hall while Sima Yuanxian held Stone Fortress.

sentences.zh: 己酉，前將軍王珣守北郊，右將軍謝琰備宣陽門。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Former General Wang Xun guarded the northern suburb; Right General Xie Yan secured Xuanyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Former General Wang Xun covered the northern approaches while Right General Xie Yan manned Xuanyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍劉牢之次新亭，使子敬宣擊敗恭，恭奔曲阿長塘湖，湖尉收送京師，斬之。

translations.literal: General Who Supports the State Liu Laozhi halted at Xinting; he sent his son Jingxuan to strike and defeat Gong; Gong fled to Changtang Lake in Qu'e; the lake warden seized him and sent him to the capital; he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Supports the State Liu Laozhi camped at Xinting and dispatched his son Liu Jingxuan against Wang Gong. Gong fled to Changtang Lake near Qu'e; the local lake officer captured him and shipped him to the capital, where he was executed.

sentences.zh: 於是遣太常殷茂喻仲堪及玄，玄等走于尋陽。

translations.literal: Thereupon Minister of Ceremonies Yin Mao was sent to instruct Zhongkan and Xuan; Xuan and the others fled to Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: The court then sent Yin Mao, Minister of Ceremonies, to reason with Yin Zhongkan and Huan Xuan; Huan Xuan and his allies withdrew toward Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，新野言騶虞見。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Xinye reported that a zouyu was seen.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Xinye reported the sighting of a zouyu—a mythical beast taken as an auspicious omen.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬午，仲堪等盟于尋陽，推桓玄爲盟主。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Zhongkan and the others made covenant at Xunyang and elevated Huan Xuan as covenant chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Yin Zhongkan and his confederates swore a pact at Xunyang and named Huan Xuan leader of the alliance.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以琅邪王德文爲衛將軍、開府儀同三司，領軍將軍王雅爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Prince of Langye Sima Dewen was appointed General Who Guards the Army with independent office and ceremony equal to the Three Elders; Wang Ya, General Who Leads the Army, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, became General Who Guards the Army with his own administrative establishment and Three Elders-level honors; Wang Ya, General Who Leads the Army, was named Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，魏王珪卽尊位，年號天興。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the twelfth month, Wei Prince Tuoba Gui assumed the honored position; era name Tianxing.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the twelfth month Tuoba Gui of Wei assumed supreme authority and adopted the reign title Tianxing.

sentences.zh: 京兆人韋禮帥襄陽流人叛，降于姚興。

translations.literal: Wei Li of Jingzhao led wandering people from Xiangyang in rebellion and surrendered to Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Li of Jingzhao rallied displaced settlers from Xiangyang in revolt and went over to Yao Xing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，前新安太守杜炯反于京口，會稽王世子元顯討斬之。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Du Jiong, former administrator of Xin'an, rebelled at Jingkou; heir of the Prince of Kuaiji Yuanxian attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Du Jiong, formerly prefect of Xin'an, mutinied at Jingkou; Sima Yuanxian, heir of the Prince of Kuaiji, crushed the rising and executed him.

sentences.zh: 禿髮烏孤自稱武威王。

translations.literal: Tufa Wugu styled himself Prince of Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Tufa Wugu proclaimed himself Prince of Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛酉，封宗室蘊爲淮陵王。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, xinyou day: imperial clansman Yun was enfeoffed as Prince of Huailing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year of Long'an, on xinyou day, Sima Yun of the imperial clan was invested as Prince of Huailing.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，河間王國鎮薨。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the second month, Prince Sima Guozhen of Hejian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the second month Sima Guozhen, Prince of Hejian, passed away.

sentences.zh: 林邑范胡達陷日南、九真，遂寇交阯，太守杜瑗討破之。

translations.literal: Fan Huda of Linyi seized Rinan and Jiuzhen, then attacked Jiaozhi; Administrator Du Yuan attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Huda of Linyi overran Rinan and Jiuzhen and pressed on toward Jiaozhi; Prefect Du Yuan struck back and broke his army.

sentences.zh: 段業自稱涼王。

translations.literal: Duan Ye styled himself King of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ye declared himself King of Liang.

sentences.zh: 仇池公楊盛遣使稱籓，獻方物。

translations.literal: Yang Sheng, Duke of Chouchi, sent envoys declaring himself a vassal and presented local produce.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sheng, lord of Chouchi, dispatched ambassadors to acknowledge tributary status and offer regional tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，追尊所生陳夫人爲德皇太后。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the third month, Lady Chen who bore him was posthumously honored as Virtuous Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the third month the emperor's birth mother, Lady Chen, was posthumously titled Virtuous Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，加尚書令王珣衛將軍，以會稽王世子元顯爲揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yiwei day: Wang Xun, Director of the Secretariat, was additionally given General Who Guards the Army; heir of the Prince of Kuaiji Yuanxian was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in summer's fourth month Wang Xun added the title General Who Guards the Army to his role as Director of the Secretariat, and Sima Yuanxian, heir of the Prince of Kuaiji, was appointed inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，以琅邪王德文爲司徒。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the sixth month, Prince of Langye Sima Dewen was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the sixth month Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 慕容德陷青州，害龍驤將軍辟閭渾，遂僭卽皇帝位于廣固。

translations.literal: Murong De seized Qingzhou and killed General Who Quickens as a Dragon Pil Hun; thereupon he usurped the imperial throne at Guanggu.
translations.idiomatic: Murong De overran Qingzhou and slew Pil Hun, General Who Quickens as a Dragon, then proclaimed himself emperor at Guanggu.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，禿髮烏孤死，其弟利鹿孤嗣偽位。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month: Tufa Wugu died; his younger brother Tufa Lilugu succeeded to the false position.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, Tufa Wugu died and his brother Tufa Lilugu inherited his unauthorized throne.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，姚興陷洛陽，執河南太守辛恭靖。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Yao Xing captured Luoyang and took Xin Gongjing, Administrator of Henan, prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Yao Xing captured Luoyang and took Xin Gongjing, prefect of Henan, prisoner.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，妖賊孫恩陷會稽，內史王凝之死之，吳國內史桓謙、臨海太守新蔡王崇、義興太守魏隱並委官而遁，吳興太守謝邈、永嘉太守司馬逸皆遇害。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month, the sorcerer-bandit Sun En seized Kuaiji; Interior Secretary Wang Ningzhi died in the affair; Wu Interior Secretary Huan Qian, Linhai Administrator Prince Chong of Xin Cai, and Yixing Administrator Wei Yin all cast aside office and fled; Wuxing Administrator Xie Miao and Yongjia Administrator Sima Yi were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the eleventh month the rebel Sun En overran Kuaiji; Wang Ningzhi, the interior secretary, perished. Huan Qian of Wu commandery, Prince Chong of Xin Cai at Linhai, and Wei Yin at Yixing abandoned their posts and fled, while Xie Miao of Wuxing and Sima Yi of Yongjia were slain.

sentences.zh: 遣衛將軍謝琰、輔國將軍劉牢之逆擊，走之。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the Army Xie Yan and General Who Supports the State Liu Laozhi were dispatched to intercept and strike; they drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent General Who Guards the Army Xie Yan and General Who Supports the State Liu Laozhi to meet Sun En in battle and forced him to retreat.

sentences.zh: 十二月，桓玄襲江陵，荊州刺史殷仲堪、南蠻校尉楊佺期並遇害。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Huan Xuan attacked Jiangling; Yin Zhongkan, Inspector of Jingzhou, and Yang Quanqi, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, both met death.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Huan Xuan struck Jiangling; Yin Zhongkan, governor of Jingzhou, and Yang Quanqi, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, were both killed.

sentences.zh: 呂光立其太子紹爲天王，自號太上皇。

translations.literal: Lü Guang established his crown prince Shao as Heavenly King and styled himself Grand Supreme Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Guang installed his heir Lü Shao as Heavenly King while claiming for himself the title Grand Supreme Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日，光死，呂纂弑紹而自立。

translations.literal: That day Guang died; Lü Zuan murdered Shao and established himself.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Lü Guang died; Lü Zuan assassinated Lü Shao and seized power.

sentences.zh: 是歲，荊州大水，平地三丈。

translations.literal: This year Jingzhou suffered great flooding; three zhang on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: That year catastrophic floods struck Jingzhou, with standing water three zhang deep even on the flats.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥，大赦。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, yihai day: general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourth year of Long'an, on yihai day, the court issued a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，有星孛于奎婁，進至紫微。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the second month, there was a broom star in Kui and Lou; it advanced to Ziwei.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the second month a cometary apparition appeared between the Kui and Lou lunar lodges and swept onward into the Ziwei enclosure.

sentences.zh: 三月，彗星見于太微。

translations.literal: In the third month, a comet was seen in Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month observers sighted a comet within the Taiwei asterism.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，地震。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 孫恩寇浹口。

translations.literal: Sun En raided Jiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En attacked the Jiakou narrows.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，散騎常侍、衛將軍、東亭侯王珣卒。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the fifth month, Wang Xun, Attendant Cavalry Gentleman, General Who Guards the Army, and Marquis of Dongting, died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fifth month Wang Xun—Attendant Cavalry Gentleman, General Who Guards the Army, and Marquis of Dongting—died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，會稽內史謝琰爲孫恩所敗，死之。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, Interior Secretary of Kuaiji Xie Yan was defeated by Sun En and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Xie Yan, interior secretary of Kuaiji, fell to Sun En and was killed.

sentences.zh: 恩轉寇臨海。

translations.literal: En turned to raid Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En redirected his forces and ravaged Linhai.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengchen, first day: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On new moon gengchen in the sixth month a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 旱。

translations.literal: Drought.
translations.idiomatic: A severe drought set in.

sentences.zh: 輔國司馬劉裕破恩於南山。

translations.literal: Army Major under the General Who Supports the State Liu Yu defeated En at Nanshan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, army major on the staff of the general who supports the state, defeated Sun En at Nanshan.

sentences.zh: 恩將盧循陷廣陵，死者三千餘人。

translations.literal: Sun En's general Lu Xun seized Guangling; those who died were more than three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun, a commander under Sun En, took Guangling at a cost of more than three thousand lives.

sentences.zh: 以琅邪王師何澄爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: He Cheng, tutor to the Prince of Langye, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He Cheng, tutor to the Prince of Langye, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，太皇太后李氏崩。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renzi day: Grand Empress Dowager Lady Li died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in autumn's seventh month Grand Empress Dowager Lady Li died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大赦。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是月，姚興伐乞伏乾歸，降之。

translations.literal: That month Yao Xing attacked Qifu Gangui; he surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Yao Xing campaigned against Qifu Gangui, who submitted.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，尚書右僕射王雅卒。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the eighth month, Wang Ya, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the eighth month Wang Ya, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，葬文太后于脩平陵。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Empress Dowager Wen was buried at Xiuping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Dowager Wen was interred at the Xiuping tomb.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the ninth month, earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day in the ninth month another earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，寧朔將軍高雅之及孫恩戰於餘姚，王師敗績。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month: General Who Pacifies the North Gao Yazhi joined battle with Sun En at Yuyao; the royal army suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, Gao Yazhi, General Who Pacifies the North, fought Sun En at Yuyao and the imperial troops were routed.

sentences.zh: 以揚州刺史元顯爲後將軍、開府儀同三司、都督揚豫徐兗青幽冀幷荊江司雍梁益交廣十六州諸軍事，前將軍劉牢之爲鎮北將軍，封元顯子彥璋爲東海王。

translations.literal: Yuanxian, Inspector of Yangzhou, was made Rear General and accorded ceremony equal to the Three Elders with independent office and Area Commander-in-Chief over military affairs of sixteen provinces; Former General Liu Laozhi was made General Who Guards the North; Yuanxian's son Yanzhang was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yuanxian, inspector of Yangzhou, was promoted to Rear General with Three Elders honors and an independent command covering sixteen provinces; Former General Liu Laozhi became General Who Guards the North; Yuanxian's son Yanzhang received the title Prince of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，有星孛于天市。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day of the twelfth month, there was a broom star in the Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the twelfth month a cometary tail appeared in the Celestial Market asterism.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河右諸郡奉涼武昭王李玄盛爲秦涼二州牧、涼公，年號庚子。

translations.literal: This year the commanderies west of the river elevated Li Xuansheng, Martial Illustrious King of Liang, as Governor of Qin and Liang and Duke of Liang; era name Gengzi.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Hexi region rallied behind Li Xuansheng—honored posthumously as Martial Illustrious King of Liang—as governor of Qin and Liang and Duke of Liang, inaugurating the reign title Gengzi.

sentences.zh: 五年春二月丙子，孫恩復寇浹口。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, second month, bingzi day: Sun En again raided Jiakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the fifth year of Long'an, on bingzi day, Sun En struck Jiakou once more.

sentences.zh: 呂超殺呂纂，以其兄隆僭卽偽位。

translations.literal: Lü Chao killed Lü Zuan and installed his elder brother Long in usurpation of the false position.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Chao assassinated Lü Zuan and elevated his brother Lü Long to the illegitimate throne.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，衆星西流，歷太微。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the third month, many stars flowed westward, passing through Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the third month a meteor shower swept westward across the Taiwei asterism.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，孫恩寇𣺣瀆，吳國內史袁山松死之。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: Sun En raided Hudu; Yuan Shansong, Wu Interior Secretary, died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fifth month Sun En assaulted the Hudu narrows on the coast near modern Shanghai; Yuan Shansong, interior secretary of Wu commandery, died defending them.

sentences.zh: 沮渠蒙遜殺段業，自號大都督、北涼州牧。

translations.literal: Juqu Mengxun killed Duan Ye and styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief and Governor of Northern Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Juqu Mengxun slew Duan Ye and proclaimed himself Grand Commander-in-Chief and governor of northern Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，孫恩至丹徒。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the sixth month, Sun En arrived at Dantu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the sixth month Sun En's fleet reached Dantu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，內外戒嚴，百官入居于省。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, inner and outer regions were placed under martial law; the hundred officials entered residence in the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the capital region went on full alert and civil officials billeted themselves inside the palace compounds.

sentences.zh: 冠軍將軍高素、右衛將軍張崇之守石頭，輔國將軍劉襲柵斷淮口，丹陽尹司馬恢之戍南岸，冠軍將軍桓謙、輔國將軍司馬允之、遊擊將軍毛邃備白石，左衛將軍王嘏、領軍將軍孔安國屯中皇堂。

translations.literal: General Who Champions Might Gao Su and Right Guards General Zhang Chongzhi guarded Stone Fortress; General Who Supports the State Liu Xi palisaded and blocked the crossing at the Huai River mouth; Sima Huizhi, governor of Danyang, garrisoned the south bank; General Who Champions Might Huan Qian, General Who Supports the State Sima Yunzhi, and Roaming Strike General Mao Sui stood ready at Baishi; Left Guards General Wang Jia and General Who Leads the Army Kong Anguo encamped at Zhonghuang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Su, General Who Champions Might, and Zhang Chongzhi, Right Guards general, held Stone Fortress; Liu Xi, General Who Supports the State, threw up barriers athwart the Huai ford; Sima Huizhi, governor of Danyang, watched the southern shore; Huan Qian, Sima Yunzhi, and Mao Sui covered Baishi; Wang Jia and Kong Anguo—Left Guards and leader of the army—deployed at Zhonghuang Hall.

sentences.zh: 徵豫州刺史、譙王尚之衛京師。

translations.literal: Prince Shangzhi of Qiao, Inspector of Yuzhou, was summoned to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sima Shangzhi of Qiao, inspector of Yuzhou, was recalled to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 寧朔將軍高雅之擊孫恩于廣陵之郁洲，爲賊所執。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the North Gao Yazhi attacked Sun En at Yuzhou in Guangling; he was seized by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yazhi, General Who Pacifies the North, fought Sun En off the Yuzhou islands near Guangling but was captured.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，段璣殺慕容盛，盛叔父熙盡誅段氏，因僭稱尊號。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Duan Ji killed Murong Sheng; Sheng's uncle Xi executed the Duan clan to the last and thereupon usurped the honored title.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month Duan Ji assassinated Murong Sheng; Murong Xi, Murong Sheng's uncle, extirpated the Duan house and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 九月，呂隆降于姚興。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Lü Long surrendered to Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Lü Long submitted to Yao Xing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，姚興帥師侵魏，大敗而旋。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Yao Xing led troops to invade Wei; he suffered great defeat and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Yao Xing invaded Wei but was routed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是歲，饑，禁酒。

translations.literal: This year there was famine; wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck that year, and the court banned the sale and consumption of wine.

sentences.zh: 元興元年春正月庚午朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: First year of Yuanxing, spring, first month, gengwu new moon: general amnesty; era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: On new year's day gengwu in the first month of spring of the first Yuanxing year the throne proclaimed a general amnesty and adopted the new reign title.

sentences.zh: 以後將軍元顯爲驃騎大將軍、征討大都督，鎮北將軍劉牢之爲元顯前鋒，前將軍、譙王尚之爲後部，以討桓玄。

translations.literal: Rear General Yuanxian was made General Who Inspires Awe and Grand Commander-in-Chief of Conquest; General Who Guards the North Liu Laozhi was made Yuanxian's vanguard; Former General and Prince of Qiao Shangzhi was made rearguard, to punish Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yuanxian was promoted from Rear General to General Who Inspires Awe and supreme commander of the punitive expedition; Liu Laozhi, General Who Guards the North, led his van; Prince Sima Shangzhi of Qiao, Former General, covered the rear—all aimed at crushing Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，帝戎服餞元顯于西池。

translations.literal: Second month, bingwu day: the emperor in military garb feasted Yuanxian at West Pond.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the second month the emperor, dressed for campaign, held a farewell banquet for Sima Yuanxian at West Pond.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣兼侍中、齊王柔之以騶虞幡宣告荊、江二州。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: concurrently Palace Attendant and Prince of Qi Rouzhi was dispatched with the zouyu banner to proclaim to Jing and Jiang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince Sima Rouzhi of Qi—also holding Palace Attendant rank—was sent with the peace-bearing zouyu banner to publish the imperial summons in Jingzhou and Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，桓玄敗王師于姑孰，譙王尚之、齊王柔之並死之。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: Huan Xuan defeated the royal army at Gushu; Prince of Qiao Shangzhi and Prince of Qi Rouzhi both died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Huan Xuan shattered the imperial army at Gushu; Prince Sima Shangzhi of Qiao and Prince Sima Rouzhi of Qi fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 以右將軍吳隱之爲都督交廣二州諸軍事、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Right General Wu Yinzhi was made Area Commander-in-Chief of military affairs of Jiao and Guang provinces and Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yinzhi, Right General, received joint command of Guangzhou and Jiaozhou as well as the Guangzhou governorship.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，劉牢之叛降于桓玄。

translations.literal: Third month, jisi day: Liu Laozhi rebelled and surrendered to Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the third month Liu Laozhi defected and went over to Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，王師敗績于新亭，驃騎大將軍、會稽王世子元顯，東海王彥璋，冠軍將軍毛泰，遊擊將軍毛邃並遇害。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the royal army suffered defeat at Xinting; General Who Inspires Awe and heir of the Prince of Kuaiji Yuanxian, Prince of Donghai Yanzhang, General Who Champions Might Mao Tai, and Roaming Strike General Mao Sui all met death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day government troops were routed at Xinting; Sima Yuanxian—General Who Inspires Awe and heir of the Prince of Kuaiji—Prince Yanzhang of Donghai, Mao Tai (General Who Champions Might), and Mao Sui (Roaming Strike) were all killed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，桓玄自爲侍中、丞相、錄尚書事，以桓謙爲尚書僕射，遷太傅、會稽王道子于安城。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, Huan Xuan made himself Palace Attendant, Chancellor, and Recorder of Secretariat Affairs; he made Huan Qian Vice Director of the Secretariat; he transferred Grand Tutor and Prince of Kuaiji Daozi to Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Huan Xuan seized the offices of Palace Attendant, Chancellor, and overseer of the Secretariat; he installed Huan Qian as Vice Director of the Secretariat and banished Grand Tutor Sima Daozi, Prince of Kuaiji, to Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 玄俄又自稱太尉、揚州牧，總百揆，以琅邪王德文爲太宰。

translations.literal: Xuan soon also styled himself Grand Commandant and Governor of Yangzhou, overseeing all affairs; he made Prince of Langye Dewen Grand Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan shortly assumed the titles Grand Commandant and governor of Yangzhou, taking charge of every branch of government, while naming Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, Grand Minister.

sentences.zh: 臨海太守辛景擊孫恩，斬之。

translations.literal: Administrator of Linhai Xin Jing attacked Sun En and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Jing, prefect of Linhai, caught Sun En and executed him.

sentences.zh: 是月，禿髮利鹿孤死，弟辱檀嗣偽位。

translations.literal: That month Tufa Lilugu died; his younger brother Tufa Rutan succeeded to the false position.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Tufa Lilugu died and his brother Tufa Rutan inherited his self-proclaimed throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，新蔡王崇爲其奴所害。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yihai day: Prince Chong of Xin Cai was killed by his slave.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in autumn's seventh month Prince Sima Chong of Xin Cai was murdered by a household slave.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，尚書下舍災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengzi day: the lower lodgings of the Secretariat suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the eighth month fire destroyed the lower Secretariat offices.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，冀州刺史劉軌叛奔于慕容德。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Liu Gui, Inspector of Jizhou, rebelled and fled to Murong De.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Liu Gui of Jizhou defected and took refuge with Murong De.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，會稽王道子爲桓玄所害。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengshen day: Prince of Kuaiji Daozi was killed by Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the twelfth month Huan Xuan had Sima Daozi, Prince of Kuaiji, murdered.

sentences.zh: 曲赦廣陵、彭城大逆以下。

translations.literal: There was a partial amnesty for Guangling and Pengcheng down from great treason.
translations.idiomatic: The throne issued a limited amnesty for Guangling and Pengcheng, pardoning offenses short of the gravest treason.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月辛丑，建威將軍劉裕破徐道覆于東陽。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, second month, xinchou day: General Who Establishes Might Liu Yu defeated Xu Daofu at Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the second month of spring in the second year of Yuanxing, Liu Yu, General Who Establishes Might, routed Xu Daofu at Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，桓玄自稱大將軍。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Huan Xuan styled himself Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Huan Xuan assumed the title Grand General.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，冀州刺史孫無終爲桓玄所害。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Sun Wuzhong, Inspector of Jizhou, was killed by Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Huan Xuan executed Sun Wuzhong, governor of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guisi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On new moon guisi in the fourth month of summer a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，玄又自號相國、楚王。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month: Xuan also styled himself Chancellor of State and King of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, Huan Xuan added the titles Chancellor of State and King of Chu.

sentences.zh: 九月，南陽太守庾仄起義兵，爲玄所敗。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Administrator of Nanyang Yu Ze raised righteous troops; he was defeated by Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yu Ze, prefect of Nanyang, mustered loyalist forces but Huan Xuan defeated them.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬午，玄遷帝于永安宮。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, renwu day: Xuan moved the emperor to Yong'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in winter's eleventh month Huan Xuan removed the emperor to confinement in Yong'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，移太廟神主于琅邪國。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, the spirit tablets of the Grand Temple were moved to the state of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the ancestral tablets were transferred to the princedom of Langye.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，玄篡位，以帝爲平固王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day: Xuan usurped the throne; he made the emperor Prince of Pinggu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the twelfth month Huan Xuan seized the throne and demoted the sovereign to Prince of Pinggu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，帝蒙塵于尋陽。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, the emperor suffered dust in Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the dethroned emperor was taken in humiliation to Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月，帝在尋陽。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, second month: the emperor was at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the third year of Huanxuan's usurpation the emperor remained at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅夜，濤水入石頭，漂殺人戶。

translations.literal: On the night of gengyin, flood waters entered Stone Fortress, washing away and killing people and households.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengyin a storm surge poured into Stone Fortress, sweeping away lives and homes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，建武將軍劉裕帥沛國劉毅、東海何無忌等舉義兵。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, General Who Establishes Martial Might Liu Yu led Liu Yi of Pei, He Wuji of Donghai, and others in raising righteous troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Liu Yu, General Who Establishes Martial Might, together with Liu Yi of Pei, He Wuji of Donghai, and others launched the loyalist uprising.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，斬桓玄所署徐州刺史桓修于京口，青州刺史桓弘于廣陵。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Huan Xiu, whom Huan Xuan had installed as Inspector of Xuzhou, was beheaded at Jingkou; Huan Hong, Inspector of Qingzhou, was beheaded at Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the loyalists executed Huan Xiu—Huan Xuan's appointee as governor of Xuzhou—at Jingkou and slew Huan Hong, governor of Qingzhou, at Guangling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，義師濟江。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the righteous army crossed the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the loyalist host crossed the Great River.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，劉裕斬玄將吳甫之于江乘，斬皇甫敷於羅落。

translations.literal: Third month, wuwu day: Liu Yu beheaded Xuan's general Wu Fuzhi at Jiangcheng; he beheaded Huangfu Fu at Luoluo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the third month Liu Yu cut down Huan Xuan's officer Wu Fuzhi at Jiangcheng and killed Huangfu Fu at Luoluo.

sentences.zh: 己未，玄衆潰而逃。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, Xuan's host broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Huan Xuan's army collapsed in flight.

sentences.zh: 庚申，劉裕置留臺，具百官。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Liu Yu established a provisional administration and fully staffed the offices.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Liu Yu set up a caretaker government at Jiankang with a full slate of ministers.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，桓玄司徒王謐推劉裕行鎮軍將軍、徐州刺史、都督揚徐兗豫青冀幽幷八州諸軍事、假節。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Huan Xuan's Minister of Education Wang Mi recommended Liu Yu as acting General Who Garrisons the Army, Inspector of Xuzhou, Area Commander-in-Chief of military affairs of eight provinces, with delegated credentials.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Wang Mi—still formally Minister of Education under Huan Xuan's regime—nominated Liu Yu as acting General Who Garrisons the Army, governor of Xuzhou, and commander of eight provinces with plenipotentiary credentials.

sentences.zh: 劉裕以謐領揚州刺史、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Liu Yu had Mi concurrently hold Inspector of Yangzhou and Recorder of Secretariat Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu left Wang Mi in charge of Yangzhou and of daily Secretariat business.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，劉裕誅尚書左僕射王愉、愉子荊州刺史綏、司州刺史溫詳。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Liu Yu executed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Yu; Yu's son Sui, Inspector of Jingzhou; and Wen Xiang, Inspector of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Liu Yu put to death Wang Yu, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, together with Wang Sui—his son and governor of Jingzhou—and Wen Xiang, governor of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，桓玄逼帝西上。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Huan Xuan forced the emperor westward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Huan Xuan marched the captive emperor upriver toward the west.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，密詔以幽逼於玄，萬機虛曠，令武陵王遵依舊典，承制總百官行事，加侍中，餘如故。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, a secret edict stated that because the emperor was secluded and coerced by Xuan, the myriad affairs hung vacant; it ordered Prince Zun of Wuling to follow old precedent, by imperial commission oversee the conduct of the hundred offices, add Palace Attendant; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day a clandestine edict explained that the emperor, isolated under Huan Xuan's grip, could not rule; it authorized Prince Sima Zun of Wuling to exercise imperial authority over the bureaucracy according to precedent, added him as Palace Attendant, and left his other titles unchanged.

sentences.zh: 幷大赦謀反大逆己下，惟桓玄一祖之後不宥。

translations.literal: Moreover there was general amnesty from plotting rebellion and great treason downward; only descendants of one ancestor of Huan Xuan were not forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: A sweeping amnesty covered every offense short of the gravest rebellion—except for Huan Xuan's immediate patriline, who received no pardon.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，大將軍、武陵王遵稱制，總萬機。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jichou day: Grand General and Prince of Wuling Zun assumed provisional authority and oversaw the myriad affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in summer's fourth month Prince Sima Zun of Wuling—already Grand General—began ruling in the emperor's name and directed all branches of government.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，帝至江陵。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, the emperor arrived at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the emperor reached Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，輔國將軍何無忌、振武將軍劉道規及桓玄將庾稚、何澹之戰于湓口，大破之。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, General Who Supports the State He Wuji and General Who Shakes Might Liu Daogui fought Huan Xuan's generals Yu Zhi and He Danzhi at Penkou and utterly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day He Wuji (General Who Supports the State) and Liu Daogui (General Who Shakes Might) met Yu Zhi and He Danzhi—Huan Xuan's commanders—at Penkou and crushed them.

sentences.zh: 玄復逼帝東下。

translations.literal: Xuan again forced the emperor eastward downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan once more compelled the emperor to sail downriver toward the east.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，冠軍將軍劉毅及桓玄戰于崢嶸洲，又破之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guiyou day: General Who Champions Might Liu Yi joined battle with Huan Xuan at Zhengrong Isle; again defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the fifth month Liu Yi, General Who Champions Might, fought Huan Xuan at Zhengrong Isle and defeated him again.

sentences.zh: 己卯，帝復幸江陵。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, the emperor again arrived at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the emperor once more reached Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，荊州別駕王康產、南郡太守王騰之奉帝居于南郡。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Wang Kangchan, Lieutenant Governor of Jingzhou, and Wang Tengzhi, Administrator of Nan commandery, attended the emperor residing in Nan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Wang Kangchan, assistant governor of Jingzhou, and Wang Tengzhi, prefect of Nan commandery, sheltered the emperor within Nan commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬午，督護馮遷斬桓玄於貊盤洲。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Supervisor Feng Qian beheaded Huan Xuan at Mopan Isle.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Feng Qian, army supervisor, slew Huan Xuan on Mopan Isle.

sentences.zh: 乘輿反正于江陵。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned to rectitude at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign's party was restored at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔曰：「姦凶篡逆，自古有之。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day an edict stated: "Wicked traitors who usurp by violence have existed since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict proclaimed: "Treason and usurpation by villains are as old as government itself.

sentences.zh: 朕不能式遏杜漸，以致播越。

translations.literal: We could not block them at the outset and thereby caused dissemination and exile.
translations.idiomatic: We failed to stamp out the evil while it was small, and so disaster swept the throne into exile.

sentences.zh: 賴鎮軍將軍裕英略奮發，忠勇絕世，冠軍將軍毅等誠心宿著，協助同嘉謀。

translations.literal: Thanks to General Who Garrisons the Army Yu's heroic strategy bursting forth, loyalty and valor unmatched in the age; General Who Champions Might Yi and others, sincerity long manifest, assisting together in excellent plans.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, General Who Garrisons the Army, struck with brilliant strategy and devotion beyond compare; Liu Yi, General Who Champions Might, together with others whose loyalty had long been proven, shared in every wise counsel.

sentences.zh: 義聲旣振，士庶效節，社稷載安，四海齊慶。

translations.literal: Once the cry of righteousness sounded, scholar and commoner alike offered allegiance; the altars of soil and grain were again secure; within the four seas all rejoiced together.
translations.idiomatic: When their righteous cause resounded, gentlemen and commoners rallied as one, the altars stood secure again, and all within the four seas rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 其大赦，凡諸畏逼事屈逆命者，一無所問。

translations.literal: Accordingly there is general amnesty; as for all who feared coercion and bent to rebel commands, nothing shall be investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty: none who acted under duress or obeyed the usurpers' orders shall be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，奉神主人于太廟。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the spirit tablets were presented to the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuyin day the ancestral tablets were carried back into the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，桓玄故將揚武將軍桓振陷江陵，劉毅、何無忌退守尋陽，帝復蒙塵于賊營。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, jichou day: Huan Zhen, former general of Huan Xuan and General Who Displays Might, seized Jiangling; Liu Yi and He Wuji withdrew to defend Xunyang; the emperor again suffered dust in the bandit camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day of the intercalary month Huan Zhen—once Huan Xuan's officer, now General Who Displays Might—took Jiangling; Liu Yi and He Wuji fell back to Xunyang, and the emperor fell once more into rebel hands.

sentences.zh: 六月，益州刺史毛璩討偽梁州刺史桓希，斬之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Mao Qu, Inspector of Yizhou, attacked false Inspector of Liangzhou Huan Xi and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Mao Qu of Yizhou campaigned against Huan Xi—the pretender's governor of Liangzhou—and executed him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，永安皇后何氏崩。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wushen day: Empress He of Yong'an died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in autumn's seventh month Empress He of Yong'an passed away.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，祔葬穆帝章皇后于永平陵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guiyou day: Empress Zhang of Emperor Mu was jointly buried at Yongping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the eighth month Empress Zhang—consort of Emperor Mu—was laid beside him in the Yongping imperial tomb.

sentences.zh: 九月，前給事中刁騁、秘書丞王邁之謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, former Gentleman for Discussion Diao Cheng and Assistant Secretary Wang Maizhi plotted rebellion; they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Diao Cheng, erstwhile Gentleman for Discussion, and Wang Maizhi, Assistant Secretary, were executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，盧循寇廣州，刺史吳隱之爲循所敗。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Lu Xun raided Guangzhou; Inspector Wu Yinzhi was defeated by Lu Xun.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Lu Xun attacked Guangzhou and routed Wu Yinzhi, its governor.

sentences.zh: 執始興相阮腆之而還。

translations.literal: They seized Administrator of Shixing Ruan Tianzhi and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They captured Ruan Tianzhi, prefect of Shixing, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 慕容德死，兄子超嗣偽位。

translations.literal: Murong De died; his elder brother's son Murong Chao succeeded to the false position.
translations.idiomatic: Murong De died, and his nephew Murong Chao inherited his self-declared throne.

sentences.zh: 義熙元年春正月，帝在江陵。

translations.literal: First year of Yixi, spring, first month: the emperor was at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Yixi the emperor remained at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 南陽太守魯宗之起義兵，襲破襄陽。

translations.literal: Administrator of Nanyang Lu Zongzhi raised righteous troops and attacked and broke Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zongzhi, prefect of Nanyang, raised loyalist forces and stormed Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，劉毅次于馬頭。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Liu Yi halted at Matou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Liu Yi encamped at Matou.

sentences.zh: 桓振以帝屯于江津。

translations.literal: Huan Zhen stationed the emperor at Jiang Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Zhen held the emperor under guard at the Jiangjin ford.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宗之破振將溫楷于柞溪，進次紀南，爲振所敗。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Zongzhi defeated Zhen's general Wen Kai at Zuoxi, advanced and halted at Jinan, and was defeated by Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Lu Zongzhi routed Wen Kai—one of Huan Zhen's officers—at Zuoxi and pressed south to Jinan, south of the old Chu capital, where Huan Zhen defeated him.

sentences.zh: 振武將軍劉道規擊桓謙，走之。

translations.literal: General Who Shakes Might Liu Daogui attacked Huan Qian and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Daogui, General Who Shakes Might, struck Huan Qian and put him to flight.

sentences.zh: 乘輿反正，帝與琅邪王幸道規舟。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned to rectitude; the emperor and Prince of Langye boarded Daogui's boat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's escort was restored; the sovereign and Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, took refuge aboard Liu Daogui's ship.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「朕以寡德，夙纂洪緒。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day an edict stated: "We, with scant virtue, early inherited the great succession.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict read: "We possess slender virtue yet inherited the great mandate young.

sentences.zh: 不能緝熙遐邇，式遏姦宄。

translations.literal: We could not illumine harmony far and near nor stop villainy at its source.
translations.idiomatic: We failed to harmonize the realm or choke off treason before it spread.

sentences.zh: 逆臣桓玄乘釁肆亂，乃誣罔天人，篡據極位。

translations.literal: The rebellious minister Huan Xuan exploited cracks and ran riot; he deceived heaven and humanity and usurped the supreme seat.
translations.idiomatic: The traitor Huan Xuan seized on unrest to wreak havoc, deceiving both heaven and men while stealing the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕躬播越，淪胥荒裔，宣皇之基，眇焉以墜。

translations.literal: Our person was scattered in exile, sinking into distant wastes; the foundation of Emperor Xuan hung faintly as if to fall.
translations.idiomatic: We were driven into exile at the empire's edge; the patrimony of Emperor Xuan seemed ready to collapse.

sentences.zh: 賴鎮軍將軍裕忠武英斷，誠冠終古。

translations.literal: Thanks to General Who Garrisons the Army Yu being loyal, martial, heroic, and decisive—his sincerity crowns all antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Through Liu Yu—General Who Garrisons the Army—whose loyalty, courage, and resolve outshine every age,

sentences.zh: 運謀機始，貞賢協其契；

translations.literal: He deployed strategy from the inception of the plot; steadfast worthies matched his tally.
translations.idiomatic: who framed strategy from the first stirrings of rebellion while steadfast allies answered his summons,

sentences.zh: 抆淚誓衆，義士感其心。

translations.literal: He wiped tears and swore to the host; righteous men were stirred in heart.
translations.idiomatic: who wiped away tears as he pledged his army and stirred every loyal heart,

sentences.zh: 故霜戈一揮。

translations.literal: Therefore frosted halberds were waved once.
translations.idiomatic: therefore his icy blades swept forth.

sentences.zh: 巨猾奔迸，三率棱威，大憝授首。

translations.literal: Great villains fled headlong; three commands displayed awe; the chief villain surrendered his head.
translations.idiomatic: Great villains scattered in panic; allied hosts drove terror home; the arch traitor lost his head.

sentences.zh: 而孽振倡狂，嗣凶荊郢。

translations.literal: But illegitimate Zhen gave mad advocacy and continued evil in Jing and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Huan Zhen—a bastard pretender—raged anew and prolonged havoc across Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 幸天祚社稷，義旗載捷，狡徒沮潰，朕獲反正。

translations.literal: Fortunately heaven blesses the altars of soil and grain; the righteous banner carries victory; crafty men melted away; We attained restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune favored the altars: the loyalists routed every crafty foe, and We were restored.

sentences.zh: 斯實宗廟之靈，勤王之勳。

translations.literal: This is truly the spirit of the ancestral temples and merit of supporting the king.
translations.idiomatic: This owed everything to the ancestral shades and to those who marched for the throne.

sentences.zh: 豈朕一人，獨享伊祜，思與億兆，幸茲更始。

translations.literal: How could We alone enjoy this blessing? We wish together with the countless millions to rejoice in this renewal.
translations.idiomatic: How could We hoard heaven's blessing? We mean to share this fresh dawn with every household.

sentences.zh: 其大赦，改元，唯玄振一祖及同黨不在原例。

translations.literal: Accordingly there is general amnesty and change of era; only one ancestral line of Xuan and Zhen and accomplices are not within the forgiving precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty and a new reign title—except for Huan Xuan's and Huan Zhen's kin and their accomplices, who remain outside the pardon.

sentences.zh: 賜百官爵二級，鰥寡孤獨穀人五斛，大酺五日。」

translations.literal: Grant the hundred officials two ranks of nobility; widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary five hu of grain each; great feast five days."
translations.idiomatic: Advance every official two noble ranks, grant widowers, widows, orphans, and the destitute five hu of grain per head, and authorize five days of public feasting."

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，留臺備乘輿法駕，迎帝于江陵。

translations.literal: Second month, dingsi day: the provisional administration prepared the imperial law carriage and welcomed the emperor from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the second month the Jiankang caretaker court dispatched the full imperial train to escort the emperor home from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 弘農太守戴寧之、建威主簿徐惠子等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Administrator of Hongnong Dai Ningzhi and Registrar of General Who Establishes Might Xu Huizi plotted rebellion; they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Ningzhi of Hongnong and Xu Huizi—chief clerk to the general who establishes might—were executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 平西參軍譙縱害平西將軍、益州刺史毛璩，以蜀叛。

translations.literal: Army aide on the staff of the general who pacifies the west Qiao Zong murdered General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yizhou Mao Qu and rebelled with Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zong, adjutant on the western pacification staff, assassinated Mao Qu—General Who Pacifies the West and governor of Yizhou—and rose in rebellion from Shu.

sentences.zh: 三月，桓振復襲江陵，荊州刺史司馬休之奔于襄陽。

translations.literal: In the third month, Huan Zhen again attacked Jiangling; Sima Xiuzhi, Inspector of Jingzhou, fled to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Huan Zhen struck Jiangling again; Sima Xiuzhi, governor of Jingzhou, fled toward Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 建威將軍劉懷肅討振，斬之。

translations.literal: General Who Establishes Might Liu Huaisu campaigned against Zhen and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huaisu, General Who Establishes Might, brought Huan Zhen to bay and executed him.

sentences.zh: 帝至自江陵。

translations.literal: The emperor arrived from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 乙未，百官詣闕請罪。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, the hundred officials went to the palace gate to beg guilt.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the civil service gathered at the palace gate to humble themselves before the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「此非諸卿之過，其還率職。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "This is not the fault of you ministers; return and head your duties."
translations.idiomatic: An edict assured them: "You bear no blame; resume your offices."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，舉章皇后哀三日，臨于西堂。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, mourning for Empress Zhang was observed for three days; audience was held in the west hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the court observed three days of mourning for Empress Zhang, with vigil held in the western hall.

sentences.zh: 劉裕及何無忌等抗表遜位，不許。

translations.literal: Liu Yu and He Wuji and others submitted memorials declining position; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, He Wuji, and others memorialized to resign their posts; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以琅邪王德文爲大司馬，武陵王遵爲太保，加鎮軍將軍劉裕爲侍中、車騎將軍、都督中外諸軍事。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Prince of Langye Dewen was made Grand Marshal; Prince of Wuling Zun was made Grand Guardian; Liu Yu, General Who Garrisons the Army, was additionally made Palace Attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, became Grand Marshal; Prince Sima Zun of Wuling became Grand Guardian; and Liu Yu added Palace Attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and supreme command over every army at court and in the field.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔曰：「自頃國難之後，人物凋殘，常所供奉，猶不改舊，豈所以視人如傷，禹湯歸過之誡哉！

translations.literal: On the jiachen day an edict stated: "Since the recent national calamity, human affairs have withered; yet regular provisions provided have still not been altered from old practice—how could this accord with treating others' wounds as one's own, or with the admonitions by which Yu and Tang took blame upon themselves?"
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict declared: "After the realm's recent calamity the people lie in ruins, yet court expenditure remains unchanged—hardly the compassion Yu and Tang showed when they blamed themselves for every hurt in the land."

sentences.zh: 可籌量減省。」

translations.literal: Let there be calculation and reduction."
translations.idiomatic: Review every budget and cut what can be cut."

sentences.zh: 夏四月，劉裕旋鎮京口。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Liu Yu returned to garrison Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Liu Yu withdrew to his headquarters at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，餞于東堂。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, there was a farewell feast in the Eastern Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court held a farewell banquet for him in the Eastern Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，禁絹扇及摴蒲。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guiwei day: silk fans and chupu gambling were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the fifth month the throne banned silk fans and the game of chupu.

sentences.zh: 遊擊將軍、章武王秀，益州刺史司馬軌之謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Roaming Strike General and Prince of Zhangwu Sima Xiu, and Sima Guizhi, Inspector of Yizhou, plotted rebellion; they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Xiu—Roaming Strike general and Prince of Zhangwu—and Sima Guizhi, governor of Yizhou, were executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 桓玄故將桓亮、苻宏、刁預寇湘州，守將擊走之。

translations.literal: Former generals of Huan Xuan Huan Liang, Fu Hong, and Diao Yu raided Xiangzhou; defending generals struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Liang, Fu Hong, and Diao Yu—former officers of Huan Xuan—invaded Xiangzhou until local commanders beat them back.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲子，封臨川王子脩之爲會稽王。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, jiazi day: Prince Xiuzhi of Linchuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in autumn's eighth month Sima Xiuzhi, Prince of Linchuan's son, received the title Prince of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，乞付乾歸伐仇池，仇池公楊盛大破之。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month: Qifu Gangui attacked Chouchi; Yang Sheng, Duke of Chouchi, utterly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, Qifu Gangui struck Chouchi, but Yang Sheng, lord of Chouchi, shattered his army.

sentences.zh: 是歲，涼武昭王玄盛遣使奉表稱籓。

translations.literal: This year Martial Illustrious King of Liang Li Xuansheng sent envoys presenting a memorial declaring himself a vassal.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Xuansheng—honored as Martial Illustrious King of Liang—sent tribute and acknowledged Jin as suzerain.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，益州刺史司馬榮期擊譙縱將譙子明于白帝，破之。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month: Sima Rongqi, Inspector of Yizhou, attacked Qiao Zong's general Qiao Ziming at Baidi and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second Yixi year Sima Rongqi, governor of Yizhou, defeated Qiao Ziming—one of Qiao Zong's generals—at Baidi.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，封高密王子法蓮爲高陽王。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: Prince Falian of Gaomi was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fifth month Sima Falian, Prince of Gaomi's son, became Prince of Gaoyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，梁州刺史楊孜敬有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Yang Zijing, Inspector of Liangzhou, had guilt; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Yang Zijing, governor of Liangzhou, was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，論匡復之功，封車騎將軍劉裕爲豫章郡公，撫軍將軍劉毅南平郡公，右將軍何無忌安成郡公，自餘封賞各有差。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: discussing merit in restoring the dynasty, Liu Yu, General of Chariots and Cavalry, was enfeoffed as Duke of Yuzhang; Liu Yi, General Who Pacifies the Army, as Duke of Nanping; He Wuji, Right General, as Duke of Ancheng; the rest received enfeoffments and rewards each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, the court rewarded those who had restored the dynasty: Liu Yu became Duke of Yuzhang, Liu Yi Duke of Nanping, He Wuji Duke of Ancheng, while lesser honors followed merit.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以左將軍孔安國爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Left General Kong Anguo was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Kong Anguo, Left General, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月，盜殺零陵太守阮野。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, bandits killed Ruan Ye, Administrator of Lingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month bandits murdered Ruan Ye, prefect of Lingling.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月己酉，車騎將軍劉裕來朝。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, second month, jiyou day: Liu Yu, General of Chariots and Cavalry, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the second month of spring in the third Yixi year Liu Yu arrived at court from his command.

sentences.zh: 誅東陽太守殷仲文、南蠻校尉殷叔文、晉陵太守殷道叔、永嘉太守駱球。

translations.literal: Yin Zhongwen, Administrator of Dongyang; Yin Shuwen, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians; Yin Daoshu, Administrator of Jinling; and Luo Qiu, Administrator of Yongjia, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The court executed Yin Zhongwen of Dongyang, Yin Shuwen as Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, Yin Daoshu of the Jinling commandery, and Luo Qiu of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大赦，除酒禁。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, general amnesty; wine prohibition removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the throne proclaimed a general amnesty and lifted the ban on wine.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，大水。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, catastrophic floods struck.

sentences.zh: 六月，姚興將赫連勃勃僭稱天王于朔方，國號夏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Yao Xing's general Helian Bobo styled himself Heavenly King at Shuofang; state's name Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Helian Bobo, serving under Yao Xing, proclaimed himself Heavenly King at Shuofang and founded the Xia state.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuxu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On new moon wuxu in autumn's seventh month a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 汝南王遵之有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: Prince Youzhi of Runan had guilt; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sima Youzhi of Runan was executed for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 八月，遣冠軍將軍劉敬宣持節監征蜀諸軍事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Liu Jingxuan, General Who Champions Might, was dispatched bearing credentials as supervisor of military affairs for the Shu expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liu Jingxuan, General Who Champions Might, received the commission and tally to oversee the western campaign against Shu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，赫連勃勃大敗禿髮傉檀，傉檀奔于南山。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month: Helian Bobo utterly defeated Tufa Nutan; Nutan fled to Nanshan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Helian Bobo shattered Tufa Nutan's army, driving him into the southern hills.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高雲、馮跋殺慕容熙，雲僭卽帝位。

translations.literal: This year Gao Yun and Feng Ba killed Murong Xi; Yun usurped the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gao Yun and Feng Ba assassinated Murong Xi; Gao Yun then seized the throne of Yan.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲辰，以琅邪王德文領司徒，車騎將軍劉裕爲揚州刺史、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, jiachen day: Prince of Langye Dewen was given concurrent Minister of Education; Liu Yu, General of Chariots and Cavalry, was made Inspector of Yangzhou and Recorder of Secretariat Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the first month of spring Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, added the Ministry of Education to his duties; Liu Yu became governor of Yangzhou and overseer of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚申，侍中、太保、武陵王遵薨。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Palace Attendant, Grand Guardian, and Prince of Wuling Zun died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince Sima Zun of Wuling—Palace Attendant and Grand Guardian—passed away.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，散騎常侍、尚書左僕射孔安國卒。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Kong Anguo, Attendant Cavalry Gentleman and Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, died.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month Kong Anguo—Attendant Cavalry and Left Vice Director of the Secretariat—died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，加吏部尚書孟昶尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Meng Chang, Minister of Personnel, was additionally given Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Meng Chang, head of the Ministry of Personnel, became Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛卯，雷。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, xinmao day: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in winter's eleventh month thunder rolled.

sentences.zh: 梁州刺史楊思平有罪，棄市。

translations.literal: Yang Siping, Inspector of Liangzhou, had guilt; he was exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Siping, governor of Liangzhou, was executed in the marketplace for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大風拔樹。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 是月，禿髮傉檀僭卽涼王位。

translations.literal: That month Tufa Nutan usurped the Liang kingship.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Tufa Nutan proclaimed himself King of Liang.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛卯，大赦。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, xinmao day: general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the first month of spring in the fifth Yixi year the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以撫軍將軍劉毅爲衛將軍、開府儀同三司，加輔國將軍何無忌鎮南將軍。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Liu Yi, General Who Pacifies the Army, was made General Who Guards the Army with ceremony equal to the Three Elders and independent office; He Wuji, General Who Supports the State, was additionally given General Who Garrisons the South.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Liu Yi advanced to General Who Guards the Army with Three Elders honors and his own establishment; He Wuji added the title General Who Garrisons the South.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，尋陽地震。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Xunyang suffered earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the earth shook at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 二月，慕容超將慕容興宗寇宿豫，陽平太守劉千載、南陽太守趙元並爲賊所執。

translations.literal: Second month: Murong Chao's general Murong Xingzong raided Suyu; Liu Qianzai, Administrator of Yangping, and Zhao Yuan, Administrator of Nanyang, were both seized by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Murong Xingzong—under Murong Chao—struck Suyu and captured Liu Qianzai of Yangping and Zhao Yuan of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，大雪，平地數尺。

translations.literal: Third month, jihai day: great snow; on level ground several chi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the third month snow piled several feet deep on the flats.

sentences.zh: 車騎將軍劉裕帥師伐慕容超。

translations.literal: Liu Yu, General of Chariots and Cavalry, led troops to campaign against Murong Chao.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, General of Chariots and Cavalry, took the field against Murong Chao.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丙寅，震于太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, bingyin day: there was thunderclap at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in summer's sixth month lightning struck the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 劉裕大破慕容超于臨朐。

translations.literal: Liu Yu greatly defeated Murong Chao at Linqu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu shattered Murong Chao's army at Linqu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，姚興將乞伏乾歸僭稱西秦王于苑川。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Yao Xing's general Qifu Gangui styled himself Western Qin King at Yuanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Qifu Gangui—under Yao Xing—proclaimed himself King of Western Qin at Yuanchuan.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，離班弑高雲，雲將馮跋攻班，殺之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuchen day: Li Ban murdered Gao Yun; Yun's general Feng Ba attacked Ban and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the ninth month Li Ban assassinated Gao Yun; Feng Ba, Yun's general, turned on Li Ban and slew him.

sentences.zh: 跋僭卽王位，仍號燕。

translations.literal: Ba usurped the kingship; still styled Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ba seized the throne of Yan and kept the dynastic name.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，魏清河王紹弑其主珪。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Prince Shao of Qinghe of Wei murdered his lord Gui.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Tuoba Shao, Prince of Qinghe, murdered Emperor Gui of Wei.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丁亥，劉裕攻慕容超，克之，齊地悉平。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, dinghai day: Liu Yu attacked Murong Chao, overcame him; Qi lands were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the first month of spring in the sixth Yixi year Liu Yu took Murong Chao's last stronghold and brought the entire Qi region under control.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣州刺史盧循反，寇江州。

translations.literal: That month, Lu Xun, Inspector of Guangzhou, rebelled and raided Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Lu Xun, governor of Guangzhou, rose in revolt and struck Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，禿髮傉檀及沮渠蒙遜戰于窮泉，傉檀敗績。

translations.literal: Third month: Tufa Nutan and Juqu Mengxun fought at Qiongquan; Nutan suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Tufa Nutan met Juqu Mengxun at Qiongquan and was routed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鎮南將軍、江州刺史何無忌及循戰于豫章，王師敗績，無忌死之。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, He Wuji, General Who Garrisons the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, joined battle with Lu Xun at Yuzhang; the royal army suffered defeat; Wuji died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day He Wuji—General Who Garrisons the South and governor of Jiangzhou—fought Lu Xun at Yuzhang; imperial troops were shattered and He Wuji fell.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，青州刺史諸葛長民、兗州刺史劉籓、幷州刺史劉道憐乃入衛京師。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Zhuge Changmin, Inspector of Qingzhou; Liu Fan, Inspector of Yanzhou; Liu Daolian, Inspector of Bingzhou—thereupon entered to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month Zhuge Changmin of Qingzhou, Liu Fan of Yanzhou, and Liu Daolian of Bingzhou marched to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，大風，拔木。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingzi day: great wind; uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the fifth month a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 戊子，衛將軍劉毅及盧循戰于桑落洲，王師敗績。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Liu Yi, General Who Guards the Army, joined battle with Lu Xun at Sangluo Isle; the royal army suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Liu Yi fought Lu Xun at Sangluo Isle and the imperial fleet was routed.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射孟昶懼，自殺。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Meng Chang feared and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Chang, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, took his own life in despair.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the throne declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，循至淮口，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Lu Xun arrived at Huai mouth; inner and outer regions were placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Lu Xun reached the Huai ford and the capital district went on full alert.

sentences.zh: 大司馬、琅邪王德文都督宮城諸軍事，次中皇堂，太尉劉裕次石頭，梁王珍之屯南掖門，冠軍將軍劉敬宣屯北郊，輔國將軍孟懷玉屯南岸，建武將軍王仲德屯越城，廣武將軍劉懷默屯建陽門，淮口築柤浦、藥園、廷尉三壘以距之。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal and Prince of Langye Dewen commanded palace-city military affairs and halted at Zhonghuang Hall; Grand Commandant Liu Yu halted at Stone Fortress; Prince Zhenzhi of Liang garrisoned South Ye Gate; Liu Jingxuan, General Who Champions Might, garrisoned the northern suburb; Meng Huaiyu, General Who Supports the State, garrisoned the south bank; Wang Zhongde, General Who Establishes Martial Might, garrisoned Yue City; Liu Huaimo, General Who Extends Martial Might, garrisoned Jianyang Gate; at Huai mouth three ramparts Zhapu, Yaoyuan, and Tingwei were built to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye and Grand Marshal, coordinated defense of the palace enclosure from Zhonghuang Hall; Liu Yu as Grand Commandant held Stone Fortress; Prince Sima Zhenzhi of Liang guarded the south flank gate; Liu Jingxuan watched the northern approaches; Meng Huaiyu covered the river's southern bank; Wang Zhongde occupied Yue fortress; Liu Huaimo secured Jianyang Gate; and three new bastions—Zhapu, Yaoyuan, and Tingwei—rose at the Huai crossing to block Lu Xun.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，震太廟鴟尾。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, lightning struck the owl-tail ridge-beam of the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day lightning shattered the roof finials of the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，盧循遁走。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengshen day: Lu Xun fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in autumn's seventh month Lu Xun broke off and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲子，使輔國將軍王仲德、廣川太守劉鐘、河間內史蒯恩等帥衆追之。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Wang Zhongde, General Who Supports the State; Liu Zhong, Administrator of Guangchuan; Kuai En, Interior Secretary of Hejian; and others were ordered to lead hosts in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wang Zhongde, Liu Zhong of Guangchuan, Kuai En of Hejian, and others led pursuit columns after Lu Xun.

sentences.zh: 是月，盧循寇荊州，刺史劉道規、雍州刺史魯宗之等敗之。

translations.literal: That month Lu Xun raided Jingzhou; Liu Daogui, Inspector of Jingzhou; Lu Zongzhi, Inspector of Yongzhou; and others defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Lu Xun struck Jingzhou but Liu Daogui, Lu Zongzhi, and their allies drove him back.

sentences.zh: 又破徐道覆于華容，賊復走尋陽。

translations.literal: Again defeated Xu Daofu at Huarong; bandits again fled to Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Separately government troops crushed Xu Daofu at Huarong, forcing the rebels back toward Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 八月，姚興將桓謙寇江陵，劉道規敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yao Xing's general Huan Qian raided Jiangling; Liu Daogui defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Huan Qian—at Yao Xing's bidding—struck Jiangling but Liu Daogui repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，蜀賊譙縱陷巴東，守將溫祚、時延祖死之。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month: Shu bandit Qiao Zong seized Badong; defending generals Wen Zuo and Shi Yanzu died.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Qiao Zong's army from Shu overran Badong; Wen Zuo and Shi Yanzu died defending it.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，劉裕破盧循于豫章。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day: Liu Yu defeated Lu Xun at Yuzhang.
